(3) The man in the black t-shirt tilts his head back and opens his mouth wide as if howling, while the man in the tan shirt watches. (7) The man in the tan shirt looks up towards the sky, opening his mouth in a bleating gesture while the other man looks on with a smirk. (8) The man in the black shirt sticks his tongue out and looks upwards with a concentrated expression. (9) A medium close-up shows the man in the black shirt making facial expressions while his hand near his waist moves his thumb and index finger together rhythmically. (10) The man in the tan t-shirt opens his eyes and mouth extremely wide in an operatic pose, eventually breaking into laughter and walking off-screen to the right.
